Forwarding Novus’s reply below. Summary: they admit the delay, propose $50k on 12/10 and the remainder on 12/20. They haven’t looped Trevor formally yet.

Alex / Trevor,

Thanks for the quick transparency, Alex. I’m Jonas (Director, Revenue Operations) — looping in Legal for the payment plan template and Treasury for formal confirmation.

We can approve the two-tranche approach conditionally under these terms:
1) Novus signs the attached one-page payment acknowledgment by 12/08 (DocuSign or signed PDF).
2) Novus authorizes an ACH for $50,000 to post no later than 12/10. If funds do not post by 12/13, Redwood will place Novus on credit hold and suspend new capacity allocations until the account is current.
3) Remaining balance to clear by 12/20; failure to clear the balance will trigger standard collections escalation and potential service restrictions.

Please confirm today whether Trevor can sign the acknowledgement and whether Novus will route ACH or a PO referencing INV-2026-09. We’ll provide the DocuSign template and the invoice/staging statement (attached).

If Novus prefers a different cadence, propose it now with concrete clearing dates; vague assurances won’t be sufficient for leadership.

Best,
